rows.grounds: compound adjective describing the forest deity (vana-devatā) as assuming or bearing the form of the guru; links divine presence to guru centrality

items.question: What identity is attributed to the forest deity in relation to the guru?
premises: The forest deity is praised by forest people.
She is described as destroying the evils of the corrupt Kali age.
She is characterized as bearing the form of the guru.
items.inference: Therefore the forest deity is identified as manifesting in the guru's form.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role depends on the preceding verse's predicate structure.
items.plain_english: She bears the form of the guru.
